subject: integration
name: Load from EthFS files on Ethereum
summary: A source for names whose content is an EthFS file (an eth:// pointer). It reads the chunks through the Ethereum nodes the person ordered (answers from the code the person chose, judged on its own row) and holds each whole chunk against the address that names it before a byte is used; a part no address commits to is taken only from a node that proves its answers. Unpacking is size-bounded. It opens no connection, holds no key and runs nothing itself; the page it serves is judged as that site. Level 4. Judged here by its publisher.
